objective: Find the smallest general harness that matches or exceeds pinned upstream Mike answer quality with fewer provider-reported logical tokens by retaining Mike's efficient whole-document reads and adding only conventional context-curation escape hatches.
implementation_commit_policy: No performer call may start until this registration, its launcher, the implementation, and focused tests are committed together. The launcher requires HEAD to be the commit that last changed this registration and requires every experiment-scoped path to match HEAD.

mike_grep_v1.hypothesis: Mike whole-document reads remain efficient for small matters, while ordinary cross-document Grep followed by bounded Read lets the same agent curate context on long or multi-document matters.
delta: Whole-read description says a full read is shortest when a document fits and explicitly permits Grep/Read without a prior whole read.
Repeat whole-document reads are suppressed; bounded Read remains repeatable.
Ordinary global cross-document Grep and exact bounded Read are added without legal scope fields.
mike_grep_v1.surface: Seven resident tools in fixed order: read_document, find_in_document, list_documents, fetch_documents, Grep, Read, generate_docx.
mike_grep_v1.retrieval: p0-pure-coding text projection; no legal section, page, table, reference, or workflow routing.
mike_grep_v1.context: One continuous agent context; no research/drafting handoff, checkpoint, union, SLA, compiler, reviewer, or automatic context refresh. Whole reads remain available and bounded Reads remain repeatable.

mike_legal_v1.hypothesis: The same Mike-plus-Grep design may gain precision from optional deterministic section and page scopes without legal workflow machinery or renamed coding tools.
delta: The same sized inventory, whole-read description, repeat-whole-read suppression, terminal generation, global Grep, and bounded Read as mike_grep_v1.
Optional verified section and page fields are added to Grep/Read; no reference, table, or workflow scope is exposed.
mike_legal_v1.surface: The mike_grep_v1 schema plus optional exact section and page scopes on Grep and Read; ordinary unscoped behavior remains available.
mike_legal_v1.retrieval: h4 legal text projection; no task-specific routing or benchmark leakage.
mike_legal_v1.context: Otherwise byte-for-byte equivalent policy to mike_grep_v1.

mike_legal_guided_v1.hypothesis: A short task-independent instruction about when verified section/page scopes beat global Grep may unlock useful legal structure without forcing it.
delta: The sized inventory, whole-read description, repeat-whole-read suppression, terminal generation, global Grep, bounded Read, and optional section/page scopes are identical to mike_legal_v1.
Only a short general prompt explains when verified section/page scopes are useful and when ordinary global Grep/line windows or a whole read are simpler.
mike_legal_guided_v1.surface: Tool schema must be byte-identical to mike_legal_v1.
mike_legal_guided_v1.retrieval: h4 legal text projection with only general scope-selection guidance; never guess a scope and never route by benchmark task.
mike_legal_guided_v1.context: Otherwise equivalent to mike_legal_v1; the system-prompt delta is recorded exactly at runtime.

v5_reconstruction_v1.hypothesis: Reconstructing the earlier winning v5 behavior will test whether broad Grep, exact bounded Reads, progressive disclosure, and one evidence-to-drafting handoff can recover quality without the later checkpoint/demand-paging stack.
v5_reconstruction_v1.surface: Resident tools are exactly Glob, Grep, Read, and describe_tools; no fetch_documents. It uses address navigation, h4 legal retrieval, progressive disclosure, the legacy pre-checkpoint drafting prompt, one fresh drafting handoff, full deterministic SLA, a 120000-character exact-evidence handoff cap, and a 120000-character provider compaction threshold.
v5_reconstruction_v1.context: Provider continuations during research followed by one fresh drafting transition; the current automatic after-batch research-context refresh is disabled. No paged checkpoint, working-set union, greenfield reviewer, or benchmark-specific prompt.

historical_v5_evidence.fidelity_caveat: The historical run launched from an unrecoverable dirty worktree, so this arm is a strategy reconstruction, not a byte-exact replay. It deliberately requests the default provider tier instead of historical fast/priority and disables the newer automatic research refresh to preserve the observed continuation-then-single-handoff topology. The current selector deliberately keeps grouped 96-character previews and does not replay the full manifest after an invalid alias; historical v5 used an ungrouped five-column manifest with roughly 180-character previews and replayed its oversized manifest after the alias error.

prelaunch_commit_gate.dynamic_run_fingerprints: Each run must fail closed unless it records exact task, instruction, source, resident/deferred tool-schema, system-prompt, harness-source, model, effort, requested/reported tier, and composite configuration SHA-256 values.

frozen_upstream_comparators.aggregate_score: 150/217 under the fixed Sol criterion judge
frozen_upstream_comparators.eligibility: Compare only when task, instructions, source bundle, Luna/high, default reported tier, and upstream-origin fingerprints match exactly.

judge.scores_are: provisional derivative LLM-judge labels, not human gold

trace_gate_before_scoring: The requested DOCX exists, opens, and is structurally valid.
The recorded task, source, prompt, tool, model, effort, tier, harness-source, and composite fingerprints match this registration.
Every tool call/result is schema-correct; errors, duplicate suppression, cache use, context rounds, tokens, and latency are inspected before judging.
mike_legal_v1 and mike_legal_guided_v1 have identical tool schemas; any scope use resolves an exact verified section or page, and ordinary unscoped calls retain their documented behavior.
v5_reconstruction_v1 has provider research continuations, no automatic after-batch research refresh, and exactly one evidence handoff before drafting.
No worktree browsing, held-out data, web result, task-specific routing, or benchmark leakage appears in a trace.
Only a general harness defect may justify a preregistered replacement run; deliverable-level Luna mistakes do not.

ordering: provider-reported logical tokens and cache-adjusted cost
decision_rule.primary_target: Match or exceed upstream Mike's aggregate accuracy while using no more provider-reported logical tokens.
decision_rule.quality_override: A candidate using more than upstream but no more than 2154717 aggregate logical tokens (1.5x) may win only with a decisive quality gain: at least 10 aggregate points, improvement on at least two of three tasks, and no material task collapse.
decision_rule.hard_rejection: A candidate over 1.5x upstream aggregate logical tokens cannot win this ablation.
